flags.message: The amicus counter (_AMICUS_RE in pipeline/interim_signals.py) matches 'amicus curiae' only, so the seven 'Brief amici curiae ...' entries on this docket are not counted: the frozen amicus_briefs=6 sits against 13 amicus filings a human would count. The counter's docstring registers one-entry-many-filers as a deliberate undercount, but the singular/plural miss looks unintentional and materially understates the stakes signal on multi-filer dockets like this one. My amicus-increment claim is stated against the counter's own semantics, so the cell is consistent either way.
